title: incident-bot: oncall runbook autodiagnostics enhancement - prioritize quicklinks & context enrichment
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: improve on-call efficiency by surfacing prioritized runbook quicklinks and richer SLO/context hints directly in incident-bot autodiagnostics. Customers repeatedly ask for faster access to the most relevant runbooks during SLO fires and oncall rotations; this PR updates heuristics and UI payloads to reduce time-to-triage. Summary of changes: 1) scoring: introduce a weighted quicklink scoring function that combines recent-runbook-hit-rate, SLO-impact, and owner-oncall-score; 2) context enrichment: attach SLO summary, recent error-rate snippets, and a compact runbook short-description to each quicklink payload; 3) UI/format: add a compact quicklinks card schema for on-call messages (max 5 links, short titles, TTL-based caching); 4) telemetry: emit new metrics (incident_bot.runbook.quicklink_score, incident_bot.runbook.selected_by_oncall, incident_bot.runbook.cache_hit) and tracing spans for scoring; 5) tests: unit and integration tests for scoring and payload serialization, and an end-to-end canary that validates message rendering with sample incidents; 6) docs: update runbook authoring guide with best-practices for short-descriptions and tagging. Backwards compatibility: default quicklink scoring uses previous fallback ordering when insufficient signals are available. Checklist: - [x] scoring algorithm implemented and unit-tested - [x] integration test against SLO toolkit mocks - [x] telemetry metrics emitted and documented - [x] docs updated in incident-bot runbook authoring page - [x] feature gated (feature flag: oncall_runbook_quicklinks_v2) Rollout plan: behind a feature flag; enable for internal canary teams for 24h, monitor new metrics and oncall feedback, then ramp to 25% of on-call messages, followed by full rollout. Regression/rollback: toggle feature flag off; caches use short TTL to avoid long-lived mismatches. Testing notes: initial CI run had a flaky e2e related to message rendering; added an extra wait and stabilized the fixture. Observability: dashboards updated to show quicklink selection rate and average score by SLO namespace. Related: builds on work in ENG-4122 (runbook compact cards) and PM-1032 (oncall UX improvements).
